name: @obvia/collections
description: Immutable, fluent and deeply typed collections for TypeScript.

scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test:unit: bun run build && bun test tests/unit
scripts.test:behavior: bun run build && bun test tests/behavior
scripts.test:guards: bun run build && bun test tests/guards
scripts.test:contracts: bun run build && bun test tests/contracts
scripts.test:properties: bun run build && bun test tests/properties
scripts.test:performance: bun run build && bun test tests/performance
scripts.test:docs: bun run build && bun test tests/behavior/readme-contract.test.ts
scripts.test:runtime: bun run build && bun test tests/unit tests/behavior tests/guards tests/contracts tests/properties tests/performance
scripts.test:coverage: bun run build && bun test --coverage tests/unit tests/behavior tests/guards tests/contracts tests/properties tests/performance
scripts.test: bun run test:runtime && bun run test:types
scripts.benchmark: bun run build && bun run benchmarks/collection.bench.ts
scripts.benchmark:ci: bun run build && bun run benchmarks/collection.bench.ts --profile=ci
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.verify:package: bun run clean && bun run build && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepack: bun run clean && bun run build

author: Selçuk Çukur <selcukcukur@outlook.com.tr>
